14:Te1c,<p><strong>tldr:</strong> the backup password was a password I use for everything. Just never tried it.</p>
<ol>
<li>New phone, Authy locked, AWS root gone</li>
<li>AWS recovery: email worked, phone call never came</li>
<li>Help docs useless, support requires login, login requires MFA</li>
<li>CLI hack: created IAM user with full permissions, logged into console</li>
<li>"Only the root user can manage root credentials." Button greyed out</li>
<li>New AWS account just to file a support case</li>
<li>Support agents not on MFA team, got into an argument</li>
<li>MFA team called brother's phone while he was driving, nobody understood</li>
<li>International calling was off the whole time</li>
<li>Enabled it, got the OTP, account unlocked</li>
<li>Went back to Authy, typed a common password. It worked. The tokens were never lost. Just forgot the unlock password</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<p>New iPhone. Transferred everything from the old phone over a USB-C cable at the Apple Store. My banking app was fine. Authy was completely locked. Every token locked behind a backup password I couldn't remember. My AWS root account lived inside that app. This was the root account, not an IAM user I could just recreate.</p>
<p>Never took recovery codes seriously. Got my phone number, got my email. As long as Gmail works, nothing is truly lost. Authy just proved that wrong.</p>
<h2>circular logic</h2>
<p>AWS has a process for lost MFA: email verification, then a phone call. Submitted the form. Got the email. No call. Tried three times. Nothing.</p>
<p>Help docs all said the same thing: log in from another device and disable MFA. Filing a support case requires being logged in. To log in, need MFA.</p>
<p><strong>There's no way out of that.</strong></p>
<h2>the CLI hack</h2>
<p>Still had root access keys in the CLI. Created an IAM user, gave it <code>PowerUserAccess</code> and <code>IAMFullAccess</code>, set a console password with <code>aws iam create-login-profile</code>. Logged in. Navigated to Root access management.</p>
<p><strong>I spent twenty minutes thinking I'd cracked it.</strong></p>
<p>The button was greyed out. Only the root user can manage root credentials. It's hardcoded. Root stays root, and nothing overrides that.</p>
<h2>support</h2>
<p>Created a new AWS account just to file a case. Got an AI-generated reply linking the MFA recovery form. The form I already filled out. Three times. Reached a person, wrong team. Reached another person, still wrong team. Got into an argument with one of them.</p>
<p>Finally a chat agent connected me to the actual MFA team. They needed to call. Gave them my number and my brother's as backup. Brother picked up while driving. Couldn't understand a word. Put it on speaker, neither could I. My phone? Silent.</p>
<p>The chat agent asked: <strong>"Do you have international calling enabled?"</strong></p>
<p><strong>"Do you have international calling enabled?"</strong></p>
<p><strong>"Do you have international calling enabled?"</strong></p>
<p>Called the telecom provider. International incoming calls disabled by default. Spent half an hour flipping that switch. MFA team called back, thick accent, switched to email. They sent an OTP. Typed it in.</p>
<p><strong>Three hours total. A spare AWS account, an argument with support, a telecom call, and my confused brother.</strong></p>
<h2>the actual ending</h2>
<p>Went back to Authy. Typed one of my usual passwords.</p>
<p>And it just worked.</p>
<p>Went from "I'm a fucking genius" to "I'm an idiot" in three hours.</p>
<p><strong>The answer was the first password I should have tried.</strong></p>15:Tcbe,
**tldr:** the backup password was a password I use for everything. Just never tried it.

1. New phone, Authy locked, AWS root gone
2. AWS recovery: email worked, phone call never came
3. Help docs useless, support requires login, login requires MFA
4. CLI hack: created IAM user with full permissions, logged into console
5. "Only the root user can manage root credentials." Button greyed out
6. New AWS account just to file a support case
7. Support agents not on MFA team, got into an argument
8. MFA team called brother's phone while he was driving, nobody understood
9. International calling was off the whole time
10. Enabled it, got the OTP, account unlocked
11. Went back to Authy, typed a common password. It worked. The tokens were never lost. Just forgot the unlock password

---

New iPhone. Transferred everything from the old phone over a USB-C cable at the Apple Store. My banking app was fine. Authy was completely locked. Every token locked behind a backup password I couldn't remember. My AWS root account lived inside that app. This was the root account, not an IAM user I could just recreate.

Never took recovery codes seriously. Got my phone number, got my email. As long as Gmail works, nothing is truly lost. Authy just proved that wrong.

## circular logic

AWS has a process for lost MFA: email verification, then a phone call. Submitted the form. Got the email. No call. Tried three times. Nothing.

Help docs all said the same thing: log in from another device and disable MFA. Filing a support case requires being logged in. To log in, need MFA.

**There's no way out of that.**

## the CLI hack

Still had root access keys in the CLI. Created an IAM user, gave it `PowerUserAccess` and `IAMFullAccess`, set a console password with `aws iam create-login-profile`. Logged in. Navigated to Root access management.

**I spent twenty minutes thinking I'd cracked it.**

The button was greyed out. Only the root user can manage root credentials. It's hardcoded. Root stays root, and nothing overrides that.

## support

Created a new AWS account just to file a case. Got an AI-generated reply linking the MFA recovery form. The form I already filled out. Three times. Reached a person, wrong team. Reached another person, still wrong team. Got into an argument with one of them.

Finally a chat agent connected me to the actual MFA team. They needed to call. Gave them my number and my brother's as backup. Brother picked up while driving. Couldn't understand a word. Put it on speaker, neither could I. My phone? Silent.

The chat agent asked: **"Do you have international calling enabled?"**

**"Do you have international calling enabled?"**

**"Do you have international calling enabled?"**

Called the telecom provider. International incoming calls disabled by default. Spent half an hour flipping that switch. MFA team called back, thick accent, switched to email. They sent an OTP. Typed it in.

**Three hours total. A spare AWS account, an argument with support, a telecom call, and my confused brother.**

## the actual ending

Went back to Authy. Typed one of my usual passwords.

And it just worked.

Went from "I'm a fucking genius" to "I'm an idiot" in three hours.

**The answer was the first password I should have tried.**
16:T1268,:Tef7,<p><strong>tldr：</strong> Authy 的備份密碼，就是我到處都在用的那組，只是我從來沒試過。</p>
<ol>
<li>換新手機，Authy 鎖住，AWS root 跟著進不去</li>
<li>AWS 的復原流程：email 驗證過了，電話一直沒打來</li>
<li>說明文件沒用，support 要先登入，登入又要 MFA</li>
<li>CLI 繞路：建一個權限全開的 IAM user，登進 console</li>
<li>「Only the root user can manage root credentials.」按鈕是灰的</li>
<li>為了開 support case，另外註冊一個 AWS 帳號</li>
<li>接到的客服都不是 MFA 團隊，還跟其中一個吵起來</li>
<li>MFA 團隊打給我弟，他正在開車，雙方都聽不懂對方</li>
<li>原來國際來電從頭到尾都是關的根本是我白痴</li>
<li>打開之後收到 OTP，帳號解鎖</li>
<li>回去 Authy 打了一組常用密碼，進去了。token 沒丟，我只是忘了解鎖用的密碼= =</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<p>換了新 iPhone，在 Apple 門市用 USB-C 線把舊手機的資料直接傳過去。銀行 app 沒事，Authy 卻整個鎖住，一打開就要輸入備份密碼，我想不起來是哪一組，就進不去 app。我的 AWS root 帳號就存在那個 app 裡。而且這是 root 帳號，不是砍掉重建就好的 IAM user。</p>
<p>recovery code 我從來沒存過。我想說手機號碼跟 email 都還在，Gmail 也登得進去，哪個帳號出事都有辦法找回來，結果 Authy 一鎖住，這些都派不上用場。</p>
<h2>鬼打牆</h2>
<p>MFA 弄丟的時候，AWS 的復原流程會先寄 email 驗證，再打一通電話過來。我填了表單，email 很快就收到了，電話卻一直沒打來，前後填了三次都一樣。</p>
<p>說明文件講的都一樣，都叫人從另一台裝置登入，把 MFA 關掉。可是 support case 要登入才能開，要登入又得先過 MFA。</p>
<p><strong>根本是 dead loop。</strong></p>
<h2>CLI 繞路</h2>
<p>CLI 裡還留著 root 的 access key。我建了一個 IAM user，給它 <code>PowerUserAccess</code> 跟 <code>IAMFullAccess</code>，再用 <code>aws iam create-login-profile</code> 設好 console 密碼。登進去之後，點進 Root access management。</p>
<p><strong>有二十分鐘我以為自己是天才呢。</strong></p>
<p>但按鈕是灰的，旁邊寫著「Only the root user can manage root credentials.」。IAM user 就算有 <code>PowerUserAccess</code> 跟 <code>IAMFullAccess</code>，root 的 MFA 還是只有 root 自己能改。</p>
<h2>客服</h2>
<p>為了開 case，我另外註冊了一個 AWS 帳號。收到的是一封 AI 寫的回覆，附上 MFA 復原表單的連結，就是我已經填過三次的那張。後來接到真人，可是部門不對，換了一個還是不對，我還跟其中一個吵了起來。</p>
<p>最後是一個 chat 客服幫我轉到真正的 MFA 團隊。他們要打電話過來，我給了自己的號碼，也給了我弟的當備用。我弟在開車時接起來，完全聽不懂對方在講什麼。他開了擴音，我也聽不懂。至於我的手機呢，一直沒響。</p>
<p>chat 客服問：<strong>「你有開國際來電嗎？」</strong></p>
<p><strong>「你有開國際來電嗎？」</strong></p>
<p><strong>「你有開國際來電嗎？」</strong></p>
<p>我打給電信公司，才知道國際來電預設是關的。光是打開這個設定就花了半小時。MFA 團隊再打來的時候，對方口音很重，後來乾脆改用 email。他們寄來一組 OTP，我輸入進去。</p>
<p><strong>前後花了三個小時。</strong></p>
<h2>真正的結局</h2>
<p>回到 Authy，打了一組我平常在用的密碼。</p>
<p>就這樣解開了。</p>
<p>三個小時之內，從「我他媽是天才」變成「我是白痴」。</p>
<p><strong>答案就是我最該先試的那組密碼。</strong></p>8:["$","div",null,{"id":"root","children":["$","main",null,{"id":"main","className":"reading","children":["$","$L13",null,{"htmlContent":"$14","rawContent":"$15","base64Content":"$16","title":"how I fucked up my MFA, lost my AWS root account :(","createdAt":"2025-11-08T21:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"$undefined","tags":["aws","cloud","mfa"],"altHtmlContent":"$17","altTitle":"我怎麼把 MFA 搞爛，弄丟 AWS root 帳號 :(","currentLang":"en","altLang":"zh","canonicalPath":"$undefined"}]}]}]
